patterns.note: Full-bleed image sections with large, impactful typography overlayed, alternating with dark, content-focused sections that maintain a consistent narrow width.
Prominent use of pixelated, monospace, and bold uppercase typography for all headings and key phrases, creating a distinct digital aesthetic.
A high-contrast palette of deep black backgrounds with vibrant neon green accents for primary headings, interactive elements, and key visual motifs.

Key textual elements like the main hero title 'SUPER EVIL GENIUS' and 'WE ALWAYS DELIVER' appear to be fixed or have a very slow parallax effect, revealing as the background content scrolls past them.
The top-left globe icon and top-right 'MENU' text remain sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent navigation access.
Project showcase sections utilize large, full-bleed background images that scroll into view, with project titles and descriptions overlaid in a minimalist fashion.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal sections as they enter the viewport, often with large background images. Key hero text elements are fixed or have a subtle parallax, creating a layered depth effect as other content scrolls beneath them. Interactive elements like the spinning globe and glitchy smiley face are animated using canvas and GSAP.
The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with high-contrast neon green text and interactive elements on a black background, creating a bold and futuristic feel.
Navigation is handled by a sticky header with a minimalist globe icon and 'MENU' text, which triggers a full-screen overlay menu that slides in from the right.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, and often pixelated display headings (~8x body) with smaller, uppercase monospace labels and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp; all elements feature hard edges with no visible corner rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; sections are clearly separated with ample vertical space, while content within sections maintains a comfortable density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a pixelated, glitchy, and neon green aesthetic on a stark black background immediately sets it apart. The bold, oversized typography combined with subtle scroll-triggered parallax and animated elements creates a unique, retro-futuristic digital experience that feels both aggressive and sophisticated.
